cohort: The study cohort consisted of 142 women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) who underwent 322 ART cycles, compared with controls having planned or unplanned natural pregnancies.
finding: ART in lupus patients with stable disease showed comparable maternal and fetal adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) to planned natural pregnancies, with a notable incidence of premature delivery, GDM, and low-birth-weight infants.
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 2653.5 ± 578.6 g, with 30.8% (20/65) classified as LBW infants, and premature infants were highly likely to be LBW/VLBW.
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery was 36.8 ± 2.1 weeks.
